context: Bangladesh scheduled LDC graduation: Nov 2026. WTO TRIPS Council waiver exempts pharmaceutical PRODUCT patents & test-data obligations for LDCs until 1 Jan 2033 - local generic makers can keep producing off-patent-in-BD molecules until then. After 2033, product patents, PVP and data exclusivity apply. This tracker gives PMD teams field-volume visibility on the molecules most exposed to that window.
